methods.name: Numbat-multiome ATAC-bin
methods.assay: Published scATAC tumor cohorts, WGS comparisons
methods.inputs: Raw fragment bin counts; SNP-level phased allele counts; bins; normalized reference per cell type
methods.outputs: HMM event states, clone and cell probabilities relative to reference
methods.mechanism: Haplotype-aware depth/allele HMM with binned accessibility
methods.reference_requirements: Reference count profiles; evaluated with annotated normal cells
methods.low_coverage_handling: Sparse allele data limit inference; exact missing-site/gap behavior needs source-level audit
methods.homozygous_deletion: No local validation; do not interpret categorical loss as absolute zero
methods.evidence: Published scATAC; current sample compatibility untested

implementation.version_or_commit: 1.5.2 declared on main, accessed 2026-10-29; commit not pinned
implementation.compute_notes: No local runtime measured; paper used 2500 cells, 8 cores, 16 GB for bin-size evaluation; smaller bins increased runtime.

methods.fit: Most relevant published comparator if SNP-level phase and defensible reference recovered
limitations: Missing phase sets and normalized reference; depth and SNP counts overlap; baseline ambiguity
Posterior calibration and dependence under this assay unresolved
Event-level arm/focal benchmark excluded segments <10% of an arm or <200 kb; separate bin-size analysis was visual in one complex sample.
uncertain: Gap/missing-emission and dependence treatment not verified
Exact commit and no-reference mode not verified

methods.name: Masked count changepoint with conditional alleles (proposed)
methods.assay: Untested transfer from count segmentation to scATAC
methods.inputs: Raw counts and exposure/covariates; retained bin coordinates; SNP-level counts and phase blocks if available
methods.outputs: Relative depth segments, boundary intervals; allele evidence or insufficient evidence
methods.mechanism: Count likelihood or heteroscedastic model for depth; conditional allele model only after dependence/phase assumptions tested; count zero retained; missing emission omitted
methods.reference_requirements: No normal required for relative boundaries; absolute loss needs anchor
methods.low_coverage_handling: Depth can yield a boundary without allele coverage; genomic gaps represented explicitly; no fabricated balance
methods.homozygous_deletion: Unsupported as definitive state without anchor and orthogonal evidence
methods.evidence: PELT/BIC-seq2 support changepoint ideas in other contexts, not this design

implementation.compute_notes: Not measured; no installation or runtime conducted.

methods.fit: Feasible depth-only diagnostic on frozen grid; joint extension blocked by phase and dependence
limitations: Accessibility and dosage confounded; adaptive boundary selection biases downstream significance
Conditional factorization must be derived from actual molecule counting; AT is SNP DP and not unique fragment count
uncertain: Likelihood, covariance and calibration require empirical validation

methods.name: Covariance-aware joint segmentation / Bayesian HMM (proposed)
methods.assay: Untested scATAC adaptation of multivariate segmentation
methods.inputs: Depth and allele observations with covariance or explicit shared-fragment generative model; phase sets; coordinates
methods.outputs: Boundary posterior or intervals; relative depth and allele-state uncertainty; abstention
methods.mechanism: Joint likelihood with missing components marginalized; distance-aware transitions; phase-block-specific nuisance orientation
methods.reference_requirements: Relative segmentation possible without normal; absolute states need identifiable anchor
methods.low_coverage_handling: Unobserved allele emission contributes no evidence; calibrated conditional dependence essential; gap uncertainty retained
methods.evidence: FACETS and original Numbat studied other designs; proposed joint model unvalidated

implementation.compute_notes: Not measured; no installation or runtime conducted.

methods.fit: Longer-term candidate once molecule counting and phasing documented
limitations: Estimated covariance unstable in sparse data; priors/transition hazard influence results
Marginalizing missing data assumes justified missingness mechanism; ascertainment may be informative
uncertain: Joint measurement model and genomic transition policy unspecified

methods.name: FACETS joint CBS and ASCAT/ASPCF
methods.assay: Bulk paired tumor-normal DNA sequencing; SNP arrays
methods.inputs: Matched normal and tumor SNP depth/allele signals; ASCAT baseline and ploidy assumptions
methods.outputs: Joint boundaries and allele-specific CN; purity/ploidy
methods.mechanism: FACETS multivariate rank-based CBS and matched normal log odds; ASCAT models admixture/ploidy
methods.reference_requirements: FACETS paired normal corrects allelic mapping bias; ASCAT requires identifying suitable solution
methods.low_coverage_handling: Sparse heterozygote weights do not create evidence; ATAC transfer untested
methods.homozygous_deletion: DNA state model can represent zero, but local ATAC identification not established

methods.name: Blind-spot image denoising / Noise2Self
methods.inputs: Noisy data and assumed suitable independent noise
methods.outputs: Denoised predictions, not independent CN evidence
methods.mechanism: Mask observations and predict from other features
methods.low_coverage_handling: Masked predictions are imputation, not observed alleles
methods.evidence: Published outside genomic CN segmentation; transfer untested

implementation.compute_notes: Not measured; no installation or runtime conducted.

methods.fit: Do not use for evidence or fill allele gaps
limitations: Spatially correlated accessibility, phase and count noise violate straightforward transfer
Can blur boundaries and hallucinate signal
uncertain: No study of this task identified

recommendations: First assess Numbat-multiome prerequisites; use depth-only count segmentation as an exploratory fallback, not CN truth.
Develop joint model only after observation dependence and phase sets are established.
Evaluate abstention and boundary uncertainty on independent truth datasets.
uncertain: All proposed joint models are unvalidated; exact commits and ASCAT license remain unverified.
